gloss: leaving school; going home from school

definitions.gloss: leaving school; going home from school
definitions.explanation: The act of leaving school to go home at the end of the school day. The opposite of {登校|とうこう} (going to school).

examples.japanese: {下校|げこう}{時間|じかん}は{三時|さんじ}だ。
{子供|こども}たちが{下校|げこう}する{時間帯|じかんたい}は{注意|ちゅうい}して{運転|うんてん}してください。
examples.english: Please drive carefully during the hours when children are leaving school.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{近|ちか}づいているため、{今日|きょう}は{早|はや}めに{下校|げこう}させることになった。
examples.english: Because a typhoon is approaching, it was decided to send the students home early today.

notes:
GRAMMAR:
Used with する: {下校|げこう}する (to leave school for home).

USAGE:
{下校|げこう} is the opposite of {登校|とうこう} (going to school). It is commonly used in school announcements and traffic safety contexts. The compound {下校|げこう}{時間|じかん} (dismissal time) and {下校|げこう}{途中|とちゅう} (on the way home from school) are frequently seen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下校|げこう}する (to go home from school)
- {下校|げこう}{時間|じかん} (school dismissal time)
- {下校|げこう}{途中|とちゅう} (on the way home from school)
- {集団|しゅうだん}{下校|げこう} (group dismissal, walking home in groups)
